newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ASJ Holdings offers 15 mln shares in Singapore IPO.
newsitem.headline: ASJ Holdings offers 15 mln shares in Singapore IPO.

text.p: Electronics firm ASJ Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was selling 15 million shares in its Singapore initial public offer (IPO) at Singapore $0.52 each.
ASJ said in a statement 11.25 million of the shares would be made available to the public and the balance would be sold via private placement.
The shares will be listed on Singapore's secondary board, SESDAQ, it said.
ASJ said it hoped to raise S$7.2 million from the IPO to allow it to expand.

Part of the proceeds would be used to acquire new machinery and research and development equipment. Some of the money would be used to establish a distribution network in Malaysia and Thailand and the remaining used to reduce bank borrowings and for working capital.
The offer would close on January 29. Trading on a when-issued basis was expected to begin on January 31, the statement said.
Schroder International Merchant Bankers Ltd had been appointed manager, lead underwriter and lead placement agent for the issue, it said.
ASJ said it expected to make a post-tax profit of S$4.48 million on a turnover of S$37.5 million in its 1996 financial year. It gave no further details.
